projects.title: Synthora AI
projects.description:
Synthora AI is a synthetic data generation platform developed during the HackDataV2 hackathon. Real-world datasets are often scarce, sensitive, or restricted by privacy requirements, which slows development, testing, and analytics. Synthora AI addresses this by generating realistic artificial data that preserves the structure and relationships of real datasets, without exposing confidential information.

My Role

As Team Lead, I directed the project from planning through delivery. I coordinated the team, assigned responsibilities, and kept the work aligned with the hackathon timeline. I also owned the platform’s entire database workflow.

Key Contributions

Database architecture: Designed the data model and controlled how data moves through the platform.
Relational integrity: Defined primary key and foreign key (PK-FK) relationships so that generated data stays consistent and valid across linked tables.
Multi-format data flow: Managed the flow of tabular, relational, and document-based data, so the platform can handle both structured and semi-structured data.
Frontend delivery: Built the user interface and deployed it on Vercel, making the platform accessible through a live web application.
Team coordination: Worked with the backend developer to integrate the database layer, backend services, and interface into a single working product.

Technical Focus

Database design, PK-FK relationship modeling, relational and document data handling, synthetic data generation, and web deployment (Vercel).

Outcome

Delivered a working, deployed prototype within the hackathon timeframe, demonstrating a practical approach to privacy-safe data generation.

projects.title: NovaSight
projects.description:
NovaSight is an AI-powered dashboard creation platform that turns raw CSV data into interactive, presentation-ready dashboards in minutes. It removes the need for manual charting and BI tool expertise, so non-technical users can explore and understand their data on their own.

My Role

As Project Lead, I led a team of five, from planning and task distribution to integration and delivery. I also contributed to the platform’s data and database design.

Key Features

CSV to dashboard: Users upload a raw CSV file, and the platform builds a dashboard automatically.
Smart chart recommendations: Suggests suitable chart types based on the structure and content of the data.
KPI cards: Highlights key metrics at a glance.
Interactive filters: Sidebar filters let users explore the data dynamically.
Export: Dashboards and results can be exported for reporting and sharing.
AI integration: Integrates the Anthropic Claude API and Gemini API to add intelligence to the analysis workflow.
Synthetic Data module (in development): A schema-builder interface for generating tabular, relational, and document datasets.

Technology Stack

Python, Streamlit, MySQL, Plotly, Anthropic Claude API, Gemini API.

Impact

NovaSight makes data analysis accessible to people without technical or BI backgrounds, cutting the time from raw data to usable insight.

projects.title: Fast Food POS
projects.description:
SmartlyPOS is a point-of-sale system for marts and retail stores, with an AI voice control layer on top. Cashiers and shop staff can speak to the system instead of searching menus and typing, which speeds up billing and reduces errors during busy hours.

Key Features

Voice price queries: Staff can ask for a product’s price by voice, for example “check price of Pepsi”, and get an instant answer.
Voice order actions: Staff can build an order by speaking, for example “add two brushes and Safina chawal to order”. The AI understands the items and quantities, adds them to the order, and calculates the total price.
Core POS functionality: A complete base system for managing products, orders, and billing, built before the voice layer is added.

Technology Stack

Frontend: React, TypeScript
Backend: FastAPI (Python)
Database: PostgreSQL
AI layer: Voice command understanding for queries and order actions

My Role

I conceived, designed, and am building the entire system on my own, from product concept and database design to the interface and AI integration.

Current Status

The base POS system is under development, and the product landing page is in progress. The voice control layer will be added once the core system is stable.

projects.title: Hotel Management System
projects.description:
The Hotel Management System is a database-driven application that manages the daily operations of a hotel in one place. It replaces manual registers and scattered records with a structured system for guest registration, room allocation, bookings, check-in and check-out, and billing.

The system keeps room availability up to date, prevents double bookings, and stores every guest record and transaction in a relational database. This gives hotel staff accurate information and reduces errors in daily work.

My role: I worked on the project as part of a team, contributing to the database design and the system’s core logic, including the relationships between guests, rooms, bookings, and billing.
